references.credit: Official shrine ordinary reference photograph;local viewing only,not redistributed or used as a texture.
references.observed: Actually inspected contemporary official oblique aerial: complete perimeter and broad open courtyard, separate central sanctuary with paired golden domes/four tall minarets, blue northern dome and small roof lanterns, flat white covered roofs/ranges, pointed-arch perimeter openings, blue/gold facades and a separate perimeter clock tower. Crowd/black mourning banners/strings/lights/temporary shades are context. Do not copy lettering, people, textures or temporary objects. Main gold domes lie along the nearly north/south sanctuary axis; exact portal/clock associations still require authoring review.

references.observed: Actually inspected night courtyard view framed by a decorated pointed arch. Twin bulbous golden domes, staged cylindrical minarets with corbelled balconies/open upper rings, gold upper lanterns/caps and a central tall rectangular iwan/arched portal. Blue/turquoise tile fields and pale stone courts. Night glow, lamps, signage and photographic decoration must not be baked into source.
